name: Weighted Muscle-Up
steps: Secure the plate at your waist using a rated attachment, then hang from the bar with an overhand grip just outside shoulder width.
Pull explosively upward while driving your elbows back to bring the bar toward your lower chest.
Keep the bar close and bring both elbows over it together as you lean your chest into the bottom of a dip.
Press powerfully down through the bar until your arms lock straight, then lower back slowly through the transition into a hang.
tips: Establish a controlled unweighted muscle-up before adding a plate.
Keep the added weight steady beneath your center of mass rather than letting it swing.
